title: How to Evaluate Reward Models for RLHF
authors_zh: Evan Frick, Tianle Li, Connor Chen, Wei-Lin Chiang, Anastasios N. Angelopoulos, Jiantao Jiao, Banghua Zhu, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Ion Stoica
paper_type_zh: 奖励模型后效预测评测与偏好代理数据论文
best_for_zh: 需要以较低成本预测奖励模型是否能带来真实 RLHF 下游人类偏好改善的研究者。
one_line: PPE evaluates reward models on human-preference and correctness proxies calibrated against real post-RLHF preference outcomes.
PPE 将 12 个领域的人类偏好与可验证正确性代理指标连接到真实 RLHF 后效，适合检验奖励数据是否真正有训练价值。
why: It provides an evidence-backed way to test whether an offline reward-model score predicts the effect that matters: downstream RLHF quality.
inclusion_reason: The release provides public preference, reward, or feedback records for training or evaluating reasoning systems.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reward models are often selected by offline pairwise accuracy, yet an RM that classifies static preference pairs well may not provide an optimizable, gaming-resistant signal that improves human satisfaction during RLHF. The relationship between proxy metrics and final policy quality therefore lacks empirical validation.

The work compares twelve offline metrics across twelve domains, performs full RLHF with candidate reward models, and conducts crowd-sourced human evaluation, building PPE to identify which proxies best predict downstream win rates.

奖励模型通常按离线 pairwise accuracy 选型，但更会判断静态偏好对的 RM，不一定能在 RLHF 中提供可优化、抗投机且提升人类满意度的奖励；代理指标与最终策略效果之间缺少实证对应。

该工作在十二个领域比较十二类离线指标，并对候选 RM 完成 RLHF 与众包人类评测，建立 PPE 以判断哪些代理最能预测下游胜率。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The central artifact is PPE, containing mappings across twelve domains, twelve proxy-metric families, and real post-RLHF human win rates. Each record organizes a task input, candidate response, reference evidence or evaluation condition, and a feedback label, together with fields needed to trace provenance and labeling. The authors use offline proxy evaluation, full RLHF, and crowdsourced human comparison for quality control, making the resource a feedback dataset for training, evaluation, or auditing rather than a generic question-answer collection. Its primary use is predicting the downstream training value of candidate reward models.

论文的核心数据对象是 PPE，规模为12个领域、12类代理指标与真实post-RLHF人类胜率映射。每条记录围绕任务输入、候选响应、参考依据或评价条件及反馈标签组织，并保留能够说明样本来源和判定过程的必要字段。作者采用离线代理评测、完整RLHF和众包人类比较控制标签质量，使数据不只是普通问答集合，而是可直接用于奖励模型评估训练、评测或审计的反馈记录。其主要用途是预测候选RM的真实下游训练价值，官方发布页提供相应数据或代码入口。与普通任务数据相比，该资源把“为何接受或拒绝候选”保存在样本结构中，使研究者能够追踪反馈合同、复核标签，并区分训练数据与隐藏评测数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Prepare tasks and inputs: Collect examples from public tasks, real model outputs, or human-written questions related to reward-model evaluation, preserving references, retrieved evidence, tests, or criteria.
  1. Generate candidates and feedback: Construct correct, incorrect, or closely matched responses for the same input and use offline proxy evaluation, full RLHF, and crowdsourced human comparison to produce candidates and preliminary labels.
  1. Verify and filter: Review boundary cases with rules, execution, model evaluation, or humans; remove ambiguous, malformed, or answer-leaking records; and retain mappings across twelve domains, twelve proxy-metric families, and real post-RLHF human win rates.
  1. Organize the usage protocol: Split data by task, error type, or capability and apply it to predicting the downstream training value of candidate reward models; model training validates data utility rather than replacing the construction process.

1. 准备任务与输入：从与奖励模型评估相关的公开任务、真实模型输出或人工问题中收集样本，并保留参考答案、检索证据、测试用例或评价标准。
  1. 生成候选与反馈：围绕同一输入构造正确、错误或质量接近的响应，通过离线代理评测、完整RLHF和众包人类比较形成可比较的候选和初始标签。
  1. 核验与筛选：对边界案例进行规则、执行器、模型或人工复核，删除标签含混、格式异常和可能泄露答案的记录，整理为12个领域、12类代理指标与真实post-RLHF人类胜率映射。
  1. 组织使用协议：按任务、错误类型或能力维度划分数据，并将其用于预测候选RM的真实下游训练价值；模型训练仅作为数据有效性验证，不替代构建流程。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper tests its central claim through controlled comparison with existing reward models, general judges, rule-based verifiers, or benchmark methods. The most representative result is that single pairwise accuracy is insufficient, while selected proxy combinations predict downstream outcomes better. This indicates that PPE exposes capability gaps missed by ordinary evaluation or provides a more useful feedback signal. Because results still depend on base models, candidate generators, judges, and task distributions, the evidence supports utility under the tested setting rather than universal effectiveness.

论文通过与现有奖励模型、通用 judge、规则验证器或基准方法的受控比较检验核心主张。最具代表性的结果是：单一pairwise accuracy不足，特定代理组合更能预测后效。这一结果说明 PPE 能暴露普通评测未覆盖的能力缺口，或为模型提供更有效的反馈信号。由于比较仍受基础模型、候选生成器、评审器和任务分布影响，该证据支持的是当前设置下的数据效用，不能单独证明其在所有领域和训练预算下都同样有效。作者还按任务类别、错误类型或模型规模进行拆分分析，以确认总体提升并非只由少数容易样本造成；这些分项结果是判断数据是否真正具有诊断性的关键。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Closest prior work usually uses general preference pairs, final-answer correctness, or one holistic score without data specifically designed for the key failures and usage conditions of reward-model evaluation. This paper changes the feedback object and evaluation contract by centering PPE and placing task input, candidate response, and auditable evidence in one record, with labels produced through offline proxy evaluation, full RLHF, and crowdsourced human comparison. The contribution is the combination of dataset construction, fine-grained organization, and practical use rather than merely another model or pairwise format.

最接近的已有工作通常使用通用偏好对、最终答案正确性或单一总体分数，但没有针对奖励模型评估中的关键错误和使用场景设计专门数据。本文真正改变的是反馈对象与评价合同：以 PPE 为中心，把任务输入、候选响应和可核查依据放在同一记录中，并通过离线代理评测、完整RLHF和众包人类比较形成标签。新意主要来自数据构造、细粒度切分和实际用途的结合，而不是简单增加一个模型或重复已有成对比较形式。因此，它改变的不只是样本数量，而是模型在训练或评测时能够看到的证据、需要预测的反馈粒度，以及最终结果可以被审计和复现的程度。

title: Limitations
局限
html: First, labels in PPE still depend on references, tests, humans, or model judges, so omissions and bias become reward blind spots. Second, although the release contains mappings across twelve domains, twelve proxy-metric families, and real post-RLHF human win rates, coverage of tasks, languages, model sources, and hard cases remains limited, and public release creates contamination risk. Third, offline scores do not automatically translate into RL, search, or deployment gains. Reuse should audit problem-level deduplication, agreement, false positives, unseen-model generalization, licensing, and category-level results.

第一，PPE 的标签仍依赖参考答案、测试、人工或模型评审，任何遗漏和偏差都会成为奖励盲区。第二，12个领域、12类代理指标与真实post-RLHF人类胜率映射虽能支持当前实验，但任务、语言、模型来源和难例分布仍有限，公开后还可能出现训练污染。第三，离线分数不必然等价于 RL、搜索或部署效果。复用前应检查题目级去重、标签一致性、假阳性、未见模型泛化和许可边界，并按子领域报告结果，不能只依赖总体平均分。此外，公开页面对许可、完整去重、生成参数或标注成本的披露可能不完整，实际复用时应以当前版本文件和仓库说明为准，不得从相似数据集推断。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For a reward-model evaluation system, PPE can serve as training data, a hidden evaluation set, or a pre-deployment audit set. Users can map tasks, candidate responses, and evaluation evidence to preferences, scores, correctness labels, or critiques. Success should combine label agreement, classification or ranking metrics, unseen-data generalization, and real gains in predicting the downstream training value of candidate reward models. Tasks without reliable references, with high error costs, or with large distribution shifts require human, executable, or expert review.

若你正在构建奖励模型评估系统，可直接使用 PPE 作为训练集、隐藏评测集或部署前审计集，按照官方字段输入任务、候选响应和评价依据，输出偏好、分数、正确性或批评反馈。有效性应通过标签一致率、分类或排序指标、未见数据泛化以及预测候选RM的真实下游训练价值后的真实收益共同确认。若目标任务缺少可靠参考、错误成本很高或分布与原数据差异明显，应增加人工、执行器或领域专家复核。建议先在固定基础模型和相同预算下建立不使用该数据的对照，再观察新增数据是否改善目标指标，并保留错误样本供人工分析，以避免只报告平均分。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: PPE uses offline proxy evaluation, full RLHF, and crowdsourced human comparison to create specialized feedback for failures that general reward-model evaluation evaluation misses.
  1. Method handle: collect tasks and candidates, generate feedback, verify boundary cases, and organize by capability; label review is the decisive quality control.
  1. Data handle: mappings across twelve domains, twelve proxy-metric families, and real post-RLHF human win rates, with records centered on inputs, candidates, evaluation evidence, and feedback labels.
  1. Evidence anchor: single pairwise accuracy is insufficient, while selected proxy combinations predict downstream outcomes better, with conclusions bounded by model, candidate, and judge configurations.
  1. Reuse decision: best suited to predicting the downstream training value of candidate reward models; contamination, false positives, and distributional stability must be checked.

1. 一句话定位：PPE 通过离线代理评测、完整RLHF和众包人类比较构建专门反馈，解决通用评价难以覆盖奖励模型评估关键错误的问题。
  1. 方法抓手：收集任务与候选、生成反馈、核验边界样本、按能力组织；决定质量的核心是标签复核。
  1. 数据抓手：12个领域、12类代理指标与真实post-RLHF人类胜率映射，记录围绕输入、候选、评价依据和反馈标签组织。
  1. 证据锚点：单一pairwise accuracy不足，特定代理组合更能预测后效，但结论受模型、候选和评审配置限制。
  1. 复用决定：最适合预测候选RM的真实下游训练价值；复用前必须检查污染、假阳性和跨分布稳定性。
